title: OTZAR — CONCISE PROFESSIONAL RESPONSE AND ORION IDENTITY RELEASE
long_winded_root_cause: System prompt lacked mandatory answer-first brevity contract; model defaulted to essay-style assistant prose.
No post-LLM polish for common filler openings/trailers.
speech_ready_text previously passed full sanitized response to TTS (essays spoken aloud).
computeVoiceOutputSupported() hard-false while premium /speak existed (UI/contract drift).
voice_mismatch_root_cause: Control Tower PREMIUM_TIMEOUT_MS=7000 aborted slow Orion TTS and silently invoked browser SpeechSynthesis.
speakWithOtzarVoice always called deviceFallback on premium failure with no allowDeviceFallback gate.
Client used /tts-preview alias (functionally ok) but path telemetry did not emphasize canonical /speak.
Founder heard robotic browser voice while UI implied premium/Orion.
response_policy: RESPONSE_BREVITY_SYSTEM_STRIP + polishResponseBrevity + toSpokenSummary(45 words). Answer first; 1–3 sentences default; detail only on request.
default_style: Sharp chief-of-staff / senior operator. Direct answer → implication → one next action max.
foundation_changes: speech-ready + otzar unit + voice-ready integration expect voice_output_supported true
control_tower_changes: allowDeviceFallback default false — no silent browser robot
AmbientOtzarBar / Voice / Welcome production paths block device fallback
